about: Free books for the AI courses. Licence notes are as the publisher states them: re-read the licence before adapting anything. Check links with node scripts/ai-courses/verify-sources.mjs --links

books.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
books.use: Spine of the Math for AI course: linear algebra, matrix calculus, probability, optimisation, then PCA/GMM/SVM derived.
books.licence: Free PDF from the authors (personal use). Read and cite; do not copy text.

books.title: Convex Optimization
books.use: Convexity, duality, KKT: the math under SVMs and regularisation.
books.licence: Free PDF from the authors. Read and cite.

books.title: Linear Algebra Done Right (4th ed.)
books.use: Proof-first linear algebra: eigen-things, spectral theorem, SVD.
books.licence: Open access (CC BY-NC). Reuse with attribution, non-commercial only: check before adapting.

books.title: Algorithms for Optimization
books.use: Gradient methods, line search, second order, stochastic methods; many figures to learn from.
books.licence: Free PDF from the authors. Read and cite.

books.title: Information Theory, Inference, and Learning Algorithms
books.use: Entropy, KL, coding, Bayesian inference, early neural nets.
books.licence: Free to read on screen from the author's site.

books.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning (Python ed.)
books.use: Gentle first ML course: regression, classification, resampling, trees, SVMs, unsupervised.
books.licence: Free PDF from the authors. Read and cite.

books.title: The Elements of Statistical Learning (2nd ed.)
books.use: The rigorous ML reference: every classical method with the math.
books.licence: Free PDF from the authors. Read and cite.

books.title: Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning
books.use: Bayesian view of ML: probability, linear models, kernels, graphical models, EM, sampling.
books.licence: Free PDF from Microsoft Research. Read and cite.

books.title: Probabilistic Machine Learning: An Introduction
books.use: Modern, complete ML from a probabilistic view; ties classical ML to deep learning.
books.licence: Free PDF (CC BY-NC-ND): read and cite, no derivatives.

books.title: Probabilistic Machine Learning: Advanced Topics
books.use: Generative models, variational inference, diffusion, RL, causality.
books.licence: Free PDF (CC BY-NC-ND): read and cite, no derivatives.

books.title: Understanding Machine Learning: From Theory to Algorithms
books.use: Learning theory: PAC, VC dimension, uniform convergence, with proofs.
books.licence: Free PDF from the authors (personal use). Read and cite.

books.title: Foundations of Machine Learning (2nd ed.)
books.use: Theory: Rademacher complexity, boosting and kernels with proofs.
books.licence: Open access from MIT Press. Read and cite.

books.title: Gaussian Processes for Machine Learning
books.use: Gaussian processes from scratch.
books.licence: Free PDF from the authors. Read and cite.

books.title: Bayesian Reasoning and Machine Learning
books.use: Graphical models and inference.
books.licence: Free PDF from the author. Read and cite.

books.title: Deep Learning
books.use: The classic DL text: math background, MLPs, regularisation, optimisation, CNNs, RNNs, generative models.
books.licence: Free to read online (HTML only). Read and cite.

books.title: Deep Learning: Foundations and Concepts
books.use: Modern DL text: transformers, diffusion, GNNs, with clean math.
books.licence: Free to read online from the authors. Read and cite.

books.title: Understanding Deep Learning
books.use: Best figures and notebooks for intuition; transformers, diffusion, RL included.
books.licence: Free PDF (CC BY-NC-ND). Read and cite; its notebooks have their own licence.

books.title: Dive into Deep Learning
books.use: Runnable chapters (PyTorch/JAX) for every DL idea; the reference for our code labs.
books.licence: Text CC BY-SA 4.0, code MIT-0: we MAY adapt with attribution (share-alike for text).

books.title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
books.use: The clearest first derivation of backprop, with interactive pieces.
books.licence: CC BY-NC 3.0: adapt with attribution, non-commercial only: check before adapting.

books.title: Speech and Language Processing (3rd ed. draft)
books.use: NLP from n-grams to transformers and LLMs.
books.licence: Free draft PDFs from the authors. Read and cite.

books.title: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd ed.)
books.use: The RL text: MDPs, DP, MC, TD, function approximation, policy gradients.
books.licence: Free PDF from the authors. Read and cite.

books.title: Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications (2nd ed.)
books.use: Classical and deep vision: geometry, features, stereo, recognition.
books.licence: Free PDF from the author (personal use). Read and cite.

books.title: Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision
books.use: Camera models and 3D geometry (paid book; the site has free sample chapters).
books.licence: Paid book: cite only.

books.title: Programming Massively Parallel Processors (4th ed.)
books.use: The GPU programming textbook: threads, memory, tiling, reductions, convolution kernels.
books.licence: Paid book (owner's Elsevier access): read and cite only.
